title: Provider Relations Policy: Network Exit of an Assigned Provider (Primary Care Provider Assignment)
content:
This policy governs what happens to a member's **Primary Care Provider Assignment** when the assigned provider leaves the Prairie Ridge network.

### Member notification

When an assigned provider leaves the network, each assigned member is notified by the **later** of two dates: the practice type's notice lead days before the exit date, and the practice type's after-receipt days after Prairie Ridge received the provider's notice. Each notice sent is recorded on the member's assignment as a provider network exit notice carrying the provider's exit date.

### Care with the exiting provider

- ~~A member in active treatment may keep seeing the exiting provider for the practice type's continuity-of-care days after the exit date.~~ **This clause is no longer in force.** It has been superseded by the current continuity-of-care basis for the continuity visits recorded on a continuity-of-care referral.
- A pregnant member may keep seeing the exiting provider through the postpartum period where the practice type provides for it (see the schedule).

### Reassignment

A member who does not choose a new PCP before the exit date is reassigned by the plan effective the exit date, and the assignment with the exiting provider ends the day before, with the end reason provider left network.

### Schedule

| Practice type | Notice lead (days before exit date) | Notice after receipt (days) | Continuity-of-care days | Pregnant member through postpartum |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Standard Primary Care Provider | 30 | 15 | 90 | Yes |
| Pediatric Primary Care Provider | 30 | 15 | 90 | No |
| OB/GYN Primary Care Provider | 30 | 15 | 90 | Yes |
| Federally Qualified Health Center Home | 30 | 15 | 90 | Yes |
| Patient-Centered Medical Home Practice | 30 | 15 | 90 | Yes |
| Specialist Serving as PCP | 30 | 15 | 90 | No |
| Health Home Lead Provider | 30 | 15 | 90 | Yes |

### Notification date: worked cases (hypothetical dates)

| Provider's exit date | Prairie Ridge received the provider's notice | 30 days before exit | 15 days after receipt | Members notified by |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 30 June | 1 June | 31 May | 16 June | 16 June (the later date) |
| 30 June | 1 April | 31 May | 16 April | 31 May (the later date) |

### Reassignment: worked case

A provider's exit date is 1 August and the member has not chosen a new PCP by then. The plan's reassignment takes effect on 1 August, and the assignment with the exiting provider ends on 31 July with the end reason provider left network.

superseded_clauses: A member in active treatment may keep seeing the exiting provider for continuity_of_care_days after the exit date
